bundleProducts.description: Yoto Says: The Wiggles’ soothing piano lullabies create a tranquil atmosphere, helping babies and toddlers drift peacefully to sleep. Drift into a dreamy world of calm with Piano Lullabies for Baby Sleep—a gentle, instrumental collection from The Wiggles, created in response to heartfelt requests from parents and carers. Thoughtfully crafted to soothe babies, toddlers, and even grown-ups, this album features soft piano renditions of timeless lullabies like Rockabye Baby, You Are My Sunshine, Hush Little Baby, and Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star. Each melody is delicately played to create a peaceful atmosphere, perfect for naptime, bedtime, or quiet moments throughout the day. Whether you're settling your little one or simply seeking a moment of calm, these lullabies offer a comforting soundtrack for rest and relaxation.“We understand firsthand the challenge of settling babies and toddlers to sleep, which is why we created this album. Our hope is that these gentle piano melodies offer a soothing solution for parents and carers, providing a peaceful pathway to bedtime for families everywhere” – Lachy Wiggle. Tracks included: Hush Little Baby Twinkle Twinkle You Are My Sunshine Baa Baa Black Sheep Brahms Lullabye Rockabye Baby Are You Sleeping Hey Diddle Diddle Row Row Your Boat Skinamarink (I Love You) Rain Medley Lavender's Blue Koala-by I Love It When It Rains Silent Night

bundleProducts.description: Yoto Says: The Wiggles are going country with a stellar list of international country artists including Dolly Parton, Lainey Wilson, Jackson Dean, MacKenzie Porter, Morgan Evans and MANY more! Yeehaw! The Wiggles are going country with their groundbreaking new album, Wiggle Up, Giddy Up!—a toe-tapping, heartwarming celebration of music, friendship, and fun. This all-new collection features never-before-heard songs from country legends like Dolly Parton and Lainey Wilson, plus exciting collaborations with stars including Morgan Evans, Dasha, MacKenzie Porter, Jackson Dean, and even the masked cowboy himself, Orville Peck! From the high-energy anthem ‘Let’s Ride!’ to the sweet and emotional ‘It’s Tough Being Three Years Old’, this album blends The Wiggles’ signature joy with the storytelling magic of country music. There’s even a special reimagining of ‘Rock-a-Bye Your Bear' with MacKenzie Porter, and a powerful message of love and belonging in ‘Friends of Dorothy’. With appearances from country icons like Slim Dusty and a lineup full of surprises, Wiggle Up, Giddy Up! is packed with heart, rhythm, and unforgettable melodies. Whether you're dancing in the living room or riding in the car, this is a musical adventure the whole family will love. Tracks included: Wiggle Up, Giddy Up! Counting 1 to 5 Friends!
